questions.explanation: Balance of payments refers to the complete details of the value of all imports and exports and other services of the country. While preparing its details, double entry system is adopted in which the details of account of a country with the rest of the world are given. Under this, there are two sides of the transaction, one which is the details of the foreign currency liabilities of the country which is called the positive side and on the other hand there is the detail of all the liabilities of that country which is called the negative side. The following items come under the credit side – (1) Unilateral transfer receipts (2) Capital transfer receipts (3) Export of factor services (4) Export of goods (5) Compensation received from foreign countries, gifts, donations, war expenses etc.
